title: ジャパンCの後に・挑戦

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond finishes the Japan Cup. Tokai Teio compliments her on her performance, as well as the blinding intensity of the gaze she turned on her opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio says that she too always strives to take on new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing that, Satono Diamond decides that she also wants to keep being a challenger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to take on any challenge and open a new chapter of history for both the Umamusume world and for the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is Satono Diamond's way of being an illustrious runner.
